brief.text: Fix dashboard preview assets, integrate it into the Musicians World website with real account details and working navigation, add Android-style mobile navigation and tasteful entrance/toast animations.
assumptions: Desktop retains the Starbucks-inspired dark green and warm cream palette.
Mobile uses Android-style bottom navigation and a two-column account-card grid.
Account values come from the signed-in session; fabricated analytics and events are removed.
Motion is subtle and respects reduced-motion preferences.

findings.fix: Remove the underlines and apply full-pill corners with a subtle pressed scale effect.
findings.problem: The hero links looked underlined and rectangular rather than like the Starbucks style's pill CTAs.
